sentences.en: In the film, the director makes Hamlet an active person.
sentences.zh: 在电影中，导演让哈姆雷特成为一个积极的人。

sentences.en: Shakespeare wrote "Hamlet" and Tolstói wrote "War and Peace".
sentences.zh: 莎士比亚写了《哈姆雷特》，托尔斯泰写了《战争与和平》。

sentences.en: Ophelia wishes Hamlet were still in love with her.
sentences.zh: 奥菲莉娅希望哈姆雷特仍然爱着她。

senses.zh: 村子,〈英〉（无教堂的）小村庄,〈比喻〉优柔寡断的人,哈姆雷特
